headline: Lumen Chemicals announces layoffs affecting 19% of workforce
body: Lumen Chemicals said it will cut 19% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Lumen Chemicals faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Lumen Chemicals. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Lumen Chemicals publishes annual sustainability report
body: Lumen Chemicals released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Lumen Chemicals opens new production line in Pune
body: Lumen Chemicals commissioned a new line at its Pune site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Lumen Chemicals to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Lumen Chemicals will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Pune. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Lumen Chemicals signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Lumen Chemicals announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.
